name: gw-coverage
note: Coverage mask: where an official (government) address exists and is shown first, with the N-Ways code beside it. Every compound has an N-Ways code. Default for every point not covered by a feature: state n-ways. Checked 2026-10-18.

properties.name: Bissau Velho, Praça / Plateau and the central avenues
properties.official: street names (Avenida Amílcar Cabral, Rua Justino Lopes ...); door numbers exist on some colonial-era and public buildings but no register or numbering plan was found
properties.rule: show the street name and door number painted or registered on the building first when there is one, with the N-Ways code beside it; postal line 1000 BISSAU
properties.evidence: 83 of the 157 named streets in OpenStreetMap's Bissau box fall in these cells; the UPU example address 'Rua Justino Lopes 12C, 1000 BISSAU'
